2609.39884.title: OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation
2609.39884.paper_summary: Role prompting elicits specialized behavior from large language models through an expert identity, offering a lightweight way to guide reasoning on demanding tasks. However, evaluating or distilling complete role-prompted answers can miss useful next-token preferences when the sampled solution remains incorrect. Transferring these preferences also requires an objective that reaches alternatives the student rarely predicts. We introduce OPSRD, which uses a fixed expert role as privileged teaching context for on-policy self-distillation without reference solutions. A role-free student generates a trajectory, and a frozen instance of the same base model supplies role-conditioned distributions on its exact prefixes, exposing alternatives beyond the sampled continuation. Teacher-weighted forward KL targets alternatives the student underestimates, with clipping to limit individual vocabulary contributions. Supervision is restricted to the highest-entropy half of student positions, concentrating learning where predictions are uncertain. Experiments on three competition-math benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B show improvements over the base models without role prompts at inference. Forward KL achieves the highest macro-averaged accuracy among the three evaluated divergences at every scale. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD.
2609.39884.paper_summary_zh: 角色提示通過專家身份引發大型語言模型的專門行為，提供了一種輕量級的方法來指導在艱巨任務上的推理。<lb/>然而，評估或提煉完整的角色提示答案可能會錯過有用的下一個標記偏好，當所採樣的解決方案仍然不正確時。<lb/>轉移這些偏好還需要一個目標，以達到學生很少預測的替代方案。<lb/>我們介紹了 OPSRD，它使用固定的專家角色作為無參考解決方案的在政策自我蒸餾的特權教學上下文。<lb/>一個無角色的學生生成一條軌跡，而同一基礎模型的凍結實例在其確切前綴上提供角色條件的分佈，揭示超出所採樣延續的替代方案。<lb/>教師加權的前向 KL 目標是學生低估的替代方案，並通過裁剪來限制個別詞彙的貢獻。<lb/>監督僅限於學生位置中熵最高的一半，集中學習在預測不確定的地方。<lb/>在三個競賽數學基準上，使用 Qwen3-1.7B、4B 和 8B 的實驗顯示，與推理時沒有角色提示的基礎模型相比有改進。<lb/>在每個規模上，前向 KL 在三種評估的散度中實現了最高的宏平均準確率。<lb/>代碼可在 https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD 獲得。
